prompt: Animate THIS EXACT approved creature, preserving its silhouette, anatomy, carved ivory mask, braided wood limbs, turquoise cloth with gold trim, amber eye and green leaves. Create a PRODUCTION TRANSPARENT sprite sheet: exactly FOUR equal columns and SEVEN equal rows = 28 frames. Tall 4:7 canvas. No text, labels, grid, borders, shadows outside the creature, projectiles, particles, or baked flash. Fixed side camera facing RIGHT. SAME PHYSICAL SCALE in every cell. Generous empty gutters, nothing touches cell boundaries. Fixed horizontal body anchor; a common floor at 85% of every cell (for flyer common flight center). Same detailed pixel clusters as reference; NOT smooth illustration and NOT coarse oversized blocks. Each row is four consecutive DISTINCT articulated poses, not a translated or resized duplicate. Rows in strict order: 1 idle breathing loop, 2 movement loop, 3 attack anticipation neutral-to-ready, 4 attack action, 5 recovery back to idle, 6 hurt recoil returning balance, 7 death buckle/fall to final inert corpse. No disappearance. Preserve character's identity in every frame. Rooted wooden owl-mask sentinel, broad ivory feathered wing mantle, turquoise tabard, THREE branch arms with golden hanging bells aimed right. Idle wing mantle and bells sway. Move is rooted stance-adjustment sway with planted roots. Anticipation three branches draw together, mantle opens. Attack branches spread to a THREE-way fan and flick their bells forward, pose changes of mantle and branches, no projectile or effects. Recovery branches recoil then fold neutral. Hurt head and trunk recoil. Death branch arms sag, wings fold, trunk buckles to a sideways corpse with bells still visible.
